result.instructions: Tools for Bookafy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What appointments does Maria have next week?"; "Which services do I offer and what are their booking links?"; "Find the customer with the email jane@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bookafy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bookafy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bookafy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bookafy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. bookafy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bookafy_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The account this API key belongs to: the admin user's email. Use it to confirm which Bookafy account is connected. GET /api/v3/me.

tools.name: bookafy_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List the appointments of ONE staff member (identified by their email: take it from bookafy_list_staff), newest first, optionally within a UTC date range. Each item has the service, customer, start/end time (UTC), title, price, duration and status. Page with page/per_page (default 25). Cancel/reschedule tokens are never returned. GET /api/v3/appointments.

staff_email.description: Email of the staff user whose appointments to list (from bookafy_list_staff).

from.description: Only appointments starting at or after this moment: yyyy-mm-dd (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

to.description: Only appointments ending before this moment: yyyy-mm-dd (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bookafy_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: WRITE: book an appointment for a customer with a staff member and service (ids from bookafy_list_staff and bookafy_list_services). The customer is created from the given name/email/phone. Bookafy may email the booking confirmation to the customer and add the event to connected calendars, so only call it when the user clearly asked to book. Times are converted to UTC. POST /api/v3/appointments.

service_id.description: Service id assigned to that staff user (from bookafy_list_services).

start.description: Start, ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:30:00-05:00.

end.description: End, ISO 8601 date-time with timezone (after start, at most 24 h later).

custom_fields.description: Custom booking-form answers as {field_name: value}, with underscores for spaces, e.g. {"What_is_your_DOB": "1990"}.

title.description: Title shown for the appointment (default: Bookafy's own).

price.description: Price of the appointment (default: the service's price).

tools.name: bookafy_update_appointment
tools.title: Update appointment
tools.description: WRITE: reschedule or edit an existing appointment. Send the required staff, service, new times and customer name — read current values with bookafy_list_appointments first. Omitted optional fields are not sent. The customer may be notified of the change. Times are converted to UTC. PUT /api/v3/appointments/{id}.

staff_user_id.description: Staff user the appointment is with.

start.description: New start, ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

end.description: New end, ISO 8601 date-time with timezone (after start, at most 24 h later).

custom_fields.description: Custom booking-form answers as {field_name: value}, with underscores for spaces, e.g. {"What_is_your_DOB": "1990"}.

tools.name: bookafy_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel appointment
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: delete (cancel) an appointment. Bookafy may notify the customer and remove the event from connected calendars, and the appointment cannot be restored through the API. Only call it when the user explicitly asked to cancel this appointment. DELETE /api/v3/appointments/{id}.

staff_user_id.description: Staff user the appointment is with (its user_id).

tools.name: bookafy_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the account's customers (id, name, email, phone and custom booking-form answers). Bookafy returns the whole list at once; use `search` (matches name, email or phone) and `limit`/`offset` to page through it. GET /api/v3/customers.

search.description: Only customers whose name, email or phone contains this text (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many matches (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset to read on.

tools.name: bookafy_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a customer record (name required; email, phone and custom booking-form answers optional). It does not book anything. POST /api/v3/customers.

custom_fields.description: Custom booking-form answers as {field_name: value}, with underscores for spaces, e.g. {"What_is_your_DOB": "1990"}.

tools.name: bookafy_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change a customer's details. Bookafy needs the name every time, so pass the current name when you only change the email or phone. Fields you leave out are not sent. PUT /api/v3/customers/{id}.

name.description: Customer's full name (required by Bookafy on every update).

custom_fields.description: Custom booking-form answers as {field_name: value}, with underscores for spaces, e.g. {"What_is_your_DOB": "1990"}.

tools.name: bookafy_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List every service (appointment type) with id, name, price, duration, buffers, category, scheduling mode and online-meeting options. Use the ids when booking. GET /api/v3/services.

tools.name: bookafy_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types with booking links
tools.description: The appointment types grouped by category, each with its public booking-page link — use it to give a customer the link to book themselves. GET /api/v3/appointment_types.

tools.name: bookafy_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List the staff users (id, name, email, booking-page URL). Use the id or email for appointments. GET /api/v3/staff_members.

tools.name: bookafy_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: List classes and one-off appointments with price, duration, location, seats, booking link and their sessions (date, seats total/filled/remaining, zoom link). GET /api/v3/classes.

tools.name: bookafy_get_class
tools.title: Get class with sessions and attendees
tools.description: One class with its sessions and the attendees booked on each (name, email, phone, booking time). Optional filters narrow the sessions. GET /api/v3/classes/{id}.

duration.description: Only sessions of this length in minutes.

attendee_name.description: Only sessions with an attendee of this name.

provider_name.description: Only sessions run by this provider.

from.description: Only sessions starting at or after this moment (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone).

to.description: Only sessions ending before this moment (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone).

tools.name: bookafy_list_session_attendees
tools.title: List session attendees
tools.description: The attendees of one class session (name, email, phone). Get session ids from bookafy_list_classes. GET /api/v3/sessions.

tools.name: bookafy_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions (id, callback URL, event type such as appointment_created or customer_updated). Read-only. GET /api/v3/api_subscriptions.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Bookafy
prompts.description: What you can do with Bookafy here, with example requests to try.
